A sample workflow for AI-assisted enquiries

A practical example of how a small business could answer repeat questions and hand anything uncertain to its team.

Webly · 9 November 2026 · Concept example · 1 min read

Start with questions you already know how to answer

Imagine a cloud kitchen that receives the same questions about serving sizes, delivery areas, and ordering cutoffs each week. Gather the answers the owner has approved and keep them in one place. Use them as the assistant’s source, so changing a delivery rule means updating one record.

Give the team control of exceptions

A visitor asking about a regular delivery area can get a short answer from the approved list. A request for an out-of-area delivery or a change to a confirmed order should go to a person. Show the customer what the assistant can handle, and make it easy to reach the team.

Check the workflow before it replies on its own

Start in draft mode and compare suggested replies with what your team would send. Check incorrect assumptions, outdated information, and questions that should be handed off. Track how often the team accepts or edits a reply before deciding whether to automate any of it.
